title: Maximum speed value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the maximum speed must be 10 m/s.

title: Resistor power value
description: Essential: The final numerical answer for the electrical power consumed by R must be 0.5 W.

title: Force balance at terminal velocity
description: Important: The solution must state that at maximum speed, the net force is zero, so the applied force equals the sum of friction and the magnetic (Ampere) force.

title: Correct Ampere force expression
description: Important: The Ampere force on the rod must be correctly derived as F_a = (B^2 * l^2 * v) / (R_total).

title: Circuit analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply Ohm's law to find the induced current, using the total resistance (R + r) and motional EMF (Blv).

title: Power calculation method
description: Important: The power in resistor R must be calculated using P = I^2 * R, with the correct current from the terminal velocity condition.

title: Sign error in force equation
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the force balance equation incorrectly adds the Ampere force to the applied force, or misplaces the friction force.

title: Resistance or EMF mistake
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the total circuit resistance is incorrectly summed (e.g., using only R or r) or if the motional EMF formula (E = Blv) is misapplied.
